---
title: "Evaluation"
format: 
  dashboard

filters:
  - jlgraves-ubc/forms
form:
  action: /api/v1/quizz
  submit: Vote!
  method: POST
  fields:
    - name: preference
      type: radio
      id: preference
      label: Compare the two datasets and choose the one in which it seems easiest for you to identify the 'best' solution.  
      values: 
        - text: Scenario A
          value: A
        - text: Scenario B
          value: B
        - text: I cannot choose 
          value: None

---
##  Row {height=70%}
```{ojs}
// | code-fold: true
// | echo: false
// | padding: 0 

Plot.plot( 
  {
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(
       data ,
        { x: "x"
        , y: "y"
        , fill: "steelblue" }

      ),
      Plot.gridX( {interval: 2.5} ),
      Plot.gridY( {interval: 2.5} ),
      Plot.axisX( [-100], {tickSize: 0
                      , label: "Best" 
                      , labelAnchor:  xAxis ? "right": "left"
                      , labelArrow: xAxis ? "right": "left"
                      , labelOffset: 10
                      , domain: [-10, 10]
      } ),
      Plot.axisY( [-100], {tickSize: 0
                      , label: "Best" 
                      , labelAnchor: yAxis ?  "top" : "bottom" 
                      , labelArrow: yAxis ?  "up":"down"
                      , labelOffset: 10
      } ),
     
    ],
    caption: "Scenario A",
    aspectRatio: 1,
    width: 400,   
    height: 400,       
    x: { label: "Best" 
        , axis: null
        , domain: [-10, 10] },
    y: { label: "Best"
        , axis: null
        , domain: [-10, 10] },
  }
)




```

```{ojs}
user_id = window.location.href.split('/').pop();
quizz = d3.json('/api/v1/quizz/' + user_id);
configuration = quizz.configurations ; 
data = d3.csv( '/api/v1/data/' +configuration.shapeKeys[0])
xAxis =configuration.orders[0]
yAxis =configuration.orders[1]


a = {
  const form = document.querySelector("form");
         // add hidden input with user_id
  const user_id = window.location.href.split('/').pop();
  let input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "user_id";
  input.value = user_id;
  form.appendChild(input);
  
  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "seed";
  input.value = configuration.seed;
  form.appendChild(input);

  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "orderKey";
  input.value = configuration.orderKey;
  form.appendChild(input);

  input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "hidden";
  input.name = "startTime";
  input.value = new Date().toISOString();
  form.appendChild(input);
}

configuration
```
